plainTranslation: A's feelings meets B's growth. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort sit right on top of your judgment about what's possible. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: One thing to look for is using comfort to avoid the truth. You may rush to make each other feel better instead of staying with what the feeling is trying to tell you.
advice: Take the support. Face the problem anyway. This connection is strongest when the encouragement helps you deal with hard things instead of avoiding them.
summaryShort: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort sit right on top of your judgment about what's possible.
